text: ROOT[process-gap]: nothing mechanically computed a failure's blocking effect, leaving the classification to narrative judgement

notes:
SYMPTOM: test_arming_smoke_binding failed for hours and was reported as 'pre-existing'/'operational' while it was actually blocking the founder's merge
  WHY1: trust-gate and adversarial-review were red
  WHY2: both run an UNFILTERED full-suite pytest, so one failing test reds both
  WHY3: the failure was classified by its HISTORY (pre-existing) not its EFFECT (blocks a required gate)
  WHY4: an R-### record number was treated as equivalent to 'accepted', i.e. recorded == non-blocking
  WHY5: nothing mechanically computed a failure's blocking effect, leaving the classification to narrative judgement
CORRECTIVE (this instance): re-ran the ingest smoke at the PR head (run 30168520046, green) and updated docs/evidence/ARMING_SMOKE_RUN.json so the binding passes
PREVENTIVE (the class): tools/blocking_failure_check.py, wired into tools/validate step 3b: reads the workflow files to find unfiltered full-suite pytest gates, names every required check a failing test reds, exits non-zero, and explicitly refuses the 'pre-existing' and 'recorded as R-###' downgrades
WHAT CHANGED (Kepner-Tregoe): this branch added worker/segment.py and changed worker/ai_extract.py + ingest.yml — all inside the armed cron's 26-file runtime closure — so the recorded smoke evidence no longer covered the head
